items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And WYNTON Thompson, one of the fellows -- one of the members of that Down magazine club... That's when the band was actually formalized.

ctx.x: And Andrade (unintelligible) was playing banjo, and then the reed section was myself and Gene Mikell still living, -- used to (unintelligible) and Gene's still playing. And WYNTON Thompson, one of the fellows -- one of the members of that Down magazine club, and he had a fine matter of fact, ten piece (band unintelligible). That's when the band was actually formalized. But he had a band before that. Then he started to change, and the men would be a little more on the swing side.
Well, did -- who would do the arrangements for this?
